Thanks for the call this morning, Jordan — good to meet the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap
- Goal: integrate Redwood Inference for document summarization for Acme Health clinical workflows (prod target Q3).
- Primary compliance concerns flagged: PHI/HIPAA requirements, SOC 2 evidence, and GDPR/data residency for EU patient subset (if any).

Action items I captured
1) Acme to confirm whether the integration will send PHI to Redwood (yes/no + approximate data categories).
2) Decide whether you want a completed SIG or a CAIQ-style response (we can prefill either).
3) Security contact for questionnaire handoff (name + email).
4) Target timeline for security review.

Clarifying questions for your team (if you can reply inline that would be great):
A) Will Acme be sending any production PHI during the pilot or only test/synthetic data?
B) Are there data residency or EU processing requirements we should plan for?
C) Will you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or is platform-managed KMS acceptable?
D) Any mandatory retention periods or audit log retention limits?

Attachments: redwood_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx (prefill draft), redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (high-level SOC 2 status).

Proposed next steps
- If you want SIG/CAIQ, reply with the preferred format and security contact and we’ll send a prefilled version + documentation.
- If HIPAA BA is required, we can add BA terms to the contract (sales/legal looped).

Thanks — I’m copying Monica (security) and Sean (sales engineering) to help with the questionnaire.

Thanks for the summary, Priyom — appreciate the clear next steps. Quick answers below, and looping in our security lead Emily.

Answers:
1) We will be sending PHI in production (lab results, notes). Pilot will use de-identified or synthetic data initially, but production is expected to include PHI.
2) Data residency: primary footprint must remain in the US. We may have an EU cohort later; will flag if/when that happens.
3) Customer-managed keys: possible ask depending on contract; default preference is platform-managed if encryption and key access controls meet our audit needs.
4) Retention: our default requirement is 7 years for clinical records; audit log retention ideally 3 years.

We will need a HIPAA BA and confirmation of SOC 2 Type II status and latest report. Our security contact is Emily Chu (emily.chu@acmehealth.com) — she will own the questionnaire.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the SIG prefill and expected turnaround time? Also please confirm encryption at rest & in transit standards.

—
Jordan Ellis
Director of Product, Acme Health
jordan.ellis@acmehealth.com

Hi Jordan / Emily — thanks for the quick responses and for looping Emily in. Below are the clarifications and our proposed handoff plan.

Quick answers to your asks:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security) — latest report available (attached: redwood_soc2_report_2025.pdf). High-level summary is attached as well.
- HIPAA BA: Redwood can execute a Business Associate Agreement and include standard BA terms in the contract. Our legal team will follow once procurement signals readiness.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS1.3 in transit. We offer customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS/HSM for Dedicated or Private deployments; hosted platform supports platform-managed KMS by default.
- Data residency: hosted US regions available; Dedicated/Private for EU residency when required.
- Audit logs / retention: default log retention is 12 months; we can extend to 36 months on request (may be part of an enterprise add-on).

SIG/CAIQ handoff proposal:
- We attached a prefilled SIG spreadsheet (redwood_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx) that Sean and I prepared. It contains answers to common control families and pointers to artifacts.
- Monica (cc'd) from our security team will be the primary owner for deeper technical evidence and any clarifying responses.
- Typical turnaround: 3–7 business days for completed prefill review + artifact collection depending on scope.

Attachments: redwood_SIG_prefill_v1.xlsx, redwood_soc2_report_2025.pdf

Next steps
1) Emily — please confirm preferred questionnaire format (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) and any portal link you prefer we upload to.
2) Confirm whether pilot will use synthetic data only or if you will share a defined PHI subset for early validation (we'll sign BA before PHI transfer).
3) I'll create a HubSpot ticket and upload the prefill/ artifacts to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood/SIG-AcmeHealth and reference deal ACME-2026-047.

Happy to hop on a 20-30m follow-up with Emily & her team if that helps.
